name: roam
desc: move your living area for a while (1-4 days): walk out toward food-rich ground (plains, forest, animals, grass) in daylight, hunt, forage and pick grass seeds on the way, remember good food/seed/water/tree places, make a night camp (pit or pillbox with a torch) where dusk finds you instead of going home, then walk home. Use it when the ground around home is used up

steps.desc: pick a heading, check the daylight
top up building blocks, torches, food, a bed
walk, forage, camp at dusk, continue next morning, until goals are met or the days are used
